description: The Insights Solution is Elexon's platform for Balancing Mechanism Reporting Service (BMRS) data on the Great Britain electricity market. Its developer portal, read on 2026-09-26, states that all APIs are public and need no key, with open API definitions in JSON, YAML and WADL. The OpenAPI definition lists 318 paths: dataset endpoints that return data as received from providers such as the transmission system operator (for example bid-offer data, physical notifications, balancing services adjustments, system frequency every two minutes, half-hourly and instantaneous generation by fuel type, indicated and initial national demand, wind forecasts and outage forecasts), streaming endpoints, opinionated endpoints for demand and generation forecasts, summaries for charts, REMIT notices and reference data on balancing mechanism units. Dataset endpoints return CSV, XML or JSON; stream endpoints return JSON. Use outside the Balancing and Settlement Code is under the BMRS Data Licence, which is royalty-free and allows commercial use with a fixed attribution statement. Data are updated continuously, for example every half hour for demand outturn. Caveats: summary endpoints are down-sampled for visualisation, and some endpoints limit request windows. Simulation uses are unit-level dispatch and balancing studies, frequency and inertia analysis, and validation of GB market models. Related records: data-entsoe-transparency-platform covers the wider European system.
